title: Q8
description:
“Mediator of the new covenant.”
Read: Exo 24:3–8, Lev 14:4–7, Num 19:6, 18
a) Exo 24 records blood sprinkled on the altar and the people. Hebrews 9:19 also mentions water, scarlet wool, hyssop, and the book. Those elements appear in other cleansing rites (Lev 14, Num 19). What does Exo 24 bring forward about a covenant put into force with blood?
